meta.note: Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. GER for SC and ST runs below the All-India ratio in every year; the gender gap within each group is what GPI measures. The AISHE API publishes GER only for SC, ST and All Categories — there is no OBC GER series to serve.

Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. The eight education levels sum exactly to the Grand Total in every year (the identities are asserted in scripts/validate.mjs). 'Others' is a residual — the API serves enrolment for SC, ST and OBC but not a plain 'Others' category, so it is computed as Grand Total minus the three named groups.

Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. TEACHERS (2021-22): the API's 'All Teacher' total row is a source defect for 2021-22 (All India = 12,904, a near-zero residual against ~1.55M the year before; the same year's 'Visiting Teacher' row carries the real total instead). The 2021-22 figure here is reconstructed as the sum of the five regular faculty types (Professor & Equivalent + Reader & Associate Professor + Lecturer/Assistant Professor + Demonstrator/Tutor + Temporary Teacher), which equals 99.0-99.2% of the published 'All Teacher' total in every clean year. Earlier years use the published 'All Teacher' total as served.

The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) is a reservation category introduced after the 2019 constitutional amendment; the API carries no EWS data before 2019-20, so that series starts there — a disclosed gap, not a fetch failure. These are enrolment counts, not rates: the denominator (the eligible population in each group) is not served, so no GER-style ratio is computed for these groups.
